tiers.note: The Division publishes a single expedited-review price per document and states no turnaround for it on this page.

evidence.quote: DOMESTIC LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY FILING FEE EXPEDITED REVIEW Articles of Organization $50.00 $25.00

notes: Hawaii is the simplest shape in the namespace so far: one flat expedited-review price of $25.00 applied per document, sitting in a column beside the base fee for every filing type rather than sold as a separate service with its own turnaround. Articles of Organization are $50.00 plus $25.00 for expedited review. Because the price is attached to the document rather than to a promised time, there is nothing on this page that says what the $25.00 buys.
needsReview: Two items: (1) what turnaround expedited review buys  -  the fee schedule states none; (2) standard processing time, not researched.

sources.citation: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Business Registration Division
